entities.name: Kjell
entities.description: Human Kannah mystic, healer and storyteller from Kaldheim, friend and mentor of Niko Aris.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: Newcomer to Kaldheim mentored by Kjell who sets out for Starnheim.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: Stirred tension between the Kannah and Omenseeker clans; later acknowledged Kjell's storytelling.

entities.name: Avtyr
entities.description: Valkyrie captured in one of Niko's shards.

entities.name: Orhaft Stoneback
entities.description: Omenseeker Vedrune who has a portal to Starnheim.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The World Serpent whose danger Niko will warn the Valkyries of.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: Clan in tension with the Kannah.

entities.name: Jutmaw
entities.description: Neutral outpost between the sea and forests.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm of the Valkyries that Niko resolves to visit.

events.summary: Kjell mentors Niko at the Jutmaw outpost, guiding Niko to win a set of armor in a gambling game.
events.quote: During a gambling game, Niko won a set of armor thanks to Kjell's guidance.

events.summary: Tension between the Kannah and Omenseekers, spurred on by Birgi, becomes a brawl watched by the Valkyries Avtyr and Rytva.
events.quote: spurred on by Birgi , which led to an all-out brawl.

events.summary: Niko captures Avtyr in a shard to prevent bloodshed and asks Orhaft for help.
events.quote: Niko captured Avtyr in one of his shards

events.summary: Niko announces he will seek Starnheim to warn the Valkyries of Koma, backed by Orhaft and Fynn.
events.quote: a decision supported by both Orhaft and Fynn.

events.summary: Kjell declines Niko's invitation to Starnheim, staying in Bretagard to manage the aftermath; Niko departs through Orhaft's portal.
events.quote: Niko invited Kjell to join them on their journey to Starnheim, but Kjell declined

relations.quote: who became a friend and mentor of Niko Aris .
influence what his leader, Fynn , hears from his surroundings.
